description: The user moved a note in the list: it now stands between these neighbours, the note above it (after) and the note below it (before), null at the list's end. notes gives it a place between theirs, and brings a deleted note back there.

about.description: The thing the list is about, when a deleted note is brought back in a list about another thing than it was: the note comes back linked to it in place of its link of the same kind. Absent otherwise.

chapter.description: The open chapter of the thing, named as a link names it.

chapterTitle.description: The open chapter's title; present exactly when chapter is.
